versions.changelog:
gmgn-portfolio 1.4.7

- Added support for Ethereum (`eth`) chain in portfolio commands.
- Introduced `portfolio created-tokens` sub-command: get tokens created by a developer wallet, including ATH market cap and migration status.
- Updated rate limit parameters: increased to 20 requests/capacity, with new per-command weights.
- Expanded description and argument hints to include wallet developer analytics and the new chain/sub-command options.
- Clarified authentication requirements for individual commands (API key/private key).
- Refined and extended CLI usage examples and documentation for new features.

- Removed support and documentation for the "created-tokens" sub-command and ETH chain; skill now supports only sol, bsc, and base.
- Updated the argument hints, sub-commands, and description to reflect the narrowed feature set.
- Removed references and documentation for deprecated/unsupported commands and chains.
- Cleaned up usage examples and option tables to match the reduced scope.
- Deleted the file: skill-card.md.

gmgn-portfolio 1.2.8

- Added Ethereum (eth) as a supported chain for all portfolio analysis commands.
- Updated usage examples and argument hints to include Ethereum.
- No code changes detected—documentation and metadata only.

gmgn-portfolio 1.2.7 changelog:

- Updated skill description for greater clarity and to explicitly mention support for developer token analytics (ATH market cap, DEX migration).
- Improved user guidance on when to use this skill (holdings, P&L, win rate, dev tokens, copy-trading decisions).
- No code changes; documentation only.

gmgn-portfolio 1.2.6

- Updated the skill description to clarify that analysis targets user-specified wallet addresses, not just the API key default wallet.
- Emphasized use cases where the user provides a wallet and wants holdings, P&L, win rate, trade history, profitability verdict, or copy-trader guidance.
- No code, command, or options changes; documentation improvements only.

gmgn-portfolio 1.2.5

- Added support for the new sub-command: portfolio created-tokens, allowing you to view tokens created by a wallet, including market cap and ATH data.
- Updated description and argument hints to reflect support for created-tokens.
- Expanded usage examples and options for querying created tokens.
- Internal documentation improved for clarity on usage scenarios and command options.
- No functional changes to existing portfolio info, holdings, activity, stats, or token-balance queries.

- Added detailed API rate limit and cooldown handling instructions, including command weights, error codes, and wait logic for 429 and ban responses.
- Clarified and simplified the skill description to focus on core portfolio queries and supported blockchains.
- Removed old references to meme coin specifics and non-essential workflow pointers.
- Updated usage instructions and examples for clarity and directness.
- Ensured explicit user communication when IPv6 is detected or when rate limits are hit, with precise retry times.
Initial release. Analyze any crypto wallet portfolio on Solana, BNB Chain, and Base Chain — holdings, PnL, win rate, trading activity, and token balances via GMGN.
